title: Kathide
description: This mod adds a new material, Kathide. This material is found in the end, and, after being processed, can be used to make incredibly powerful weapons.
body:
# Features:
### Weapons:
- ⚔️ Kathide Greatsword
  - Has a dash ability when right-clicking
- 🪓 Kathide Greataxe
  - Has a leap ability when right-clicking
- 🪨 Kathide Loadstone
  - Made with a Lodestone (Yes, I DO know how to spell it, it's intentional.)
  - When right-clicking, you save a position, when right-clicking again, you load back to that position
### Items
- 🟪 Raw Kathide
  - Edible, gives Kathide Crystalization
- 🟣 Processed Kathide
  - Used to craft the weapons
- 🪵 Netherite Handle
  - Used to craft the weapons
### Blocks
- 🪨 Kathide Ore
  - Spawns rarely in only the End
  - Damages entities that are on it
- 🟪 Block of Raw Kathide
  - Crafted from Raw Kathide
  - Damages entities that are on it
- 🟣 Block of Processed Kathide
  - Crafted from Processed Kathide
  - Fire-proof from the process
### Kathide Processing
- 📚 Raw Kathide, found in the end, is toxic to all animals, as it tries to crystalize whatever animal touches it. However, ancient builders thought to neutralize its crystalization via making an alloy with another material. The recipe for Processed Kathide was lost to time, never being found in the Overworld. People only ever heard of Kathide from rumors, never anything concrete.
